title: Novartis Exits BrainTransporter Deal with BioArctic 14 Months After Signing
content: Advertisement News|Articles|November 3, 2026 Novartis Exits BrainTransporter Deal with BioArctic 14 Months After Signing Novartis exits its BrainTransporter deal with BioArctic 14 months after signing, citing an internal portfolio decision unrelated to the platform. Advertisement Novartis has terminated its collaboration with BioArctic AB, ending a partnership designed to use BioArctic’s BrainTransporter platform to develop a new treatment for neurodegenerative disorders1 — just 14 months after the two companies signed the agreement.2BioArctic announced the termination on November 2, 2026. The Swedish biotech said Novartis decided to discontinue the program, and was clear that the exit reflects an internal Novartis portfolio decision rather than any problem with the platform itself. “The termination is unrelated to BioArctic’s BrainTransporter technology,” the company stated.The collaboration, inked in August 2025, had called for BioArctic to engineer a drug candidate by pairing BrainTransporter with an undisclosed Novartis proprietary antibody targeting neurodegeneration. Novartis would then evaluate the resulting data and decide whether to exercise an option to license the candidate and take over global development and commercialization. The deal carried an upfront payment of $30 million, with up to $772 million in potential milestone payments and tiered mid-single-digit royalties on global sales if a product reached the market. title: 一项近8亿美元的合作被终止
content: 首页 资讯 摩熵视野 交易并购 一项近8亿美元的合作被终止 一项近8亿美元的合作被终止 动脉网-最新 12小时前 查看原文 53 在启动约14个月后，诺华达成的一笔合作项目按下终止键。近日，瑞典生物技术公司BioArctic宣布，诺华已通知其终止双方于2025年8月达成的合作。双方原计划将BioArctic的BrainTransporter技术与诺华一款尚未披露的抗体结合，探索其在中枢神经系统（CNS）疾病中的应用。这笔交易曾包含3000万美元首付款，以及最高7.72亿美元的后续里程碑付款，潜在总金额达到8.02亿美元，另有分级销售提成。BioArctic在公告中表示，诺华终止项目的决定与BrainTransporter技术本身无关，同时也将保留已收到的3000万美元首付款。2026年下半年以来，诺华已接连在多个项目中折戟。在9月初，反义寡核苷酸药物pelacarsen在III期HORIZON研究中虽降低了Lp(a)水平，但未能在整体研究人群中显著减少心血管事件。数日后，通过Avidity收购获得的del-desiran在1型强直性肌营养不良症的III期HARBOR研究中未达主要终点。更早之前，其自体免疫CAR-T疗法rap-cel因三例患者死亡而暂停八项临床试验。放眼全球，血脑屏障（BBB）递送已成为MNC竞相布局的技术领域。BioArctic不仅与诺华有过合作，还先后与卫材、BMS及礼来达成协议。罗氏更是自主研发了Brainshuttle平台，其代表性候选药物trontinemab已进入Ⅲ期临床。一项尚未进入临床验证的递送技术，曾获得跨国药企数亿美元级别的潜在投入，如今合作又提前结束。放到更大的行业背景中，值得关注的其实是交易背后的技术方向：血脑屏障（BBB）递送。在一次交流中，便有资深免疫学与成果转化专家向动脉网指出，不仅是抗体和小分子药物，就连近年来备受关注的AAV（腺相关病毒）载体通常也很难进入大脑。尽管可能部分AAV可以通过BBB，但也可能是因为动物模型的特殊性或设计上的偶然，并不完全代表普遍的跨越能力。突破血脑屏障究竟还有多少难题？血脑屏障（BBB）是中枢神经系统药物研发绕不开的障碍。它主要由脑微血管内皮细胞及其紧密连接构成，并与周细胞、星形胶质细胞等共同维持中枢神经系统的微环境稳定。这套屏障能够限制外周有害物质进入大脑，但也让许多潜在药物难以抵达病灶。根据2025年发表于《Brain》的相关综述，约98%的小分子药物以及几乎所有大分子生物药都难以有效通过完整的血脑屏障。以抗体为例，静脉给药后真正进入人脑的比例可能仅约为0.1%。这意味着，即使药物在外周血液中具有足够的暴露水平，也不代表脑组织能够获得相应的药物浓度。围绕这一问题，行业已经形成了多条技术路线。其中，受体介导的跨胞转运（Receptor-Mediated Transcytosis，RMT）是目前较受关注的方向之一。其基本思路是利用血脑屏障内皮细胞表面的受体，使得药物能进入脑组织。BioArctic的BrainTransporter正是基于这一机制开发，即它利用转铁蛋白受体（TfR）介导的转运能力，将抗体等治疗分子与递送模块结合，希望提高药物进入脑内的效率。对药企而言，这类平台具有一定的模块化潜力。同一递送技术可以尝试与不同抗体或其他药物形式组合，拓展适应症和产品管线。围绕这一方向，BioArctic并非唯一的参与者。罗氏的Brainshuttle是另一项受到行业关注的技术。其代表性候选药物trontinemab，将抗Aβ抗体与TfR1介导的脑递送机制相结合，试图在提高脑内抗体暴露的同时，改善传统抗体药物的给药效率。2025年，罗氏公布了trontinemab的Ⅰb/Ⅱa期研究数据。在3.6mg/kg剂量组中，28周时有81%的受试者脑内淀粉样蛋白PET指标降至24 Centiloid以下；同期观察到ARIA-E发生率低于5%。罗氏随后启动Ⅲ期研究，进一步评估其临床疗效和安全性。此外，脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）、外泌体及其他仿生纳米载体，也在尝试为核酸药物和生物大分子寻找新的脑内递送路径。这些技术能够通过材料设计、表面修饰和靶向配体提高载荷能力及组织分布，但目前不少研究仍处于临床前探索阶段，距离形成稳定、可重复的临床递送方案尚有距离。事实上，当药物递送技术受限时，细胞疗法可能正在展现出独特的穿越能力。“T细胞天然具备进入和巡逻中枢神经系统的能力，它们可以穿过血管进入大脑，无需特殊的递送载体。”一位资深免疫学与成果转化专家对动脉网表示，在多发性硬化症（MS）患者中，使用CD19 CAR-T细胞疗法后，能够观察到脑内B细胞的清除。这种天然的组织穿透力，为细胞疗法攻克CNS疾病提供了生物学基础。不同技术路线的出现，说明BBB递送已经从单一的受体穿梭研究，扩展为分子工程、物理开放和材料递送共同参与的技术竞争。但穿过血脑屏障只是第一步。药物进入脑组织后，能否进一步抵达目标细胞、实现有效靶点结合，能否在足够长的时间内维持有效浓度，以及是否引发新的神经毒性或外周安全性问题，仍然决定着最终的治疗效果。跨国药企为什么争夺透脑能力？血脑屏障递送技术的研发难度，也正在改变大型药企的外部合作策略。BioArctic与诺华的合作，正是观察这一趋势的一个切口。2025年8月，双方签署选择权、合作和许可协议。BioArctic获得3000万美元首付款，负责将BrainTransporter与诺华自主研发的一款抗体结合，生成新的候选药物。诺华则拥有后续选择权，在评估初期合作数据后，决定是否获得候选药物许可。如果行使选择权，BioArctic还可获得最高7.72亿美元的额外里程碑付款，以及产品上市后的阶梯式中个位数销售分成。这类交易的核心，是将药物分子和递送技术拆分为两个可以协同开发的模块。大型药企通常具备成熟的抗体发现、药物开发和全球商业化能力，但并不意味着其在所有递送技术上都拥有同等优势。对于已经进入研发体系的候选药物，如果脑内暴露不足，单纯优化药物靶点或增加给药剂量未必能够解决问题。引入外部递送技术，便成为一种新的研发选择。事实上，当药物递送技术受限时，细胞疗法可能正在展现出独特的穿越能力。对BioArctic这样的技术平台公司而言，合作模式则提供了另一种商业化路径：不必完全依赖自有管线逐一推进临床开发，而是将递送技术与不同合作方的药物分子结合，通过多个项目验证平台的适用范围。事实上，诺华并非BioArctic在BrainTransporter领域的首个合作伙伴。2024年4月，BioArctic与卫材达成研究评估协议，围绕阿尔茨海默病候选药物BAN2802开展合作。双方将在初步研究后评估相关数据，由卫材决定是否行使许可选择权。同年12月，BioArctic与百时美施贵宝达成全球独家许可协议，涉及其PyroGlu-Aβ抗体项目BAN1503和BAN2803，其中BAN2803结合了BrainTransporter技术。根据BioArctic披露的交易安排，BMS将负责相关项目的全球开发及后续商业化。2026年6月，BioArctic又与礼来签订研究合作协议，将BrainTransporter与礼来一款未公开的神经退行性疾病候选药物结合。此次交易同样包含3000万美元首付款，潜在里程碑付款最高7.7亿美元，另有中个位数比例的阶梯式销售特许权使用费。从交易金额看，礼来合作与诺华此前的交易结构高度相似。更值得关注的是，BrainTransporter的应用范围正在向神经退行性疾病以外延伸。2026年8月19日，BioArctic与瑞典生物技术公司Mesenkia Therapeutics宣布开展肿瘤领域研究合作，探索胶质母细胞瘤抗体疗法。从更广的行业范围看，BBB递送的应用空间还可能延伸至帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、亨廷顿病、脑转移瘤以及部分中枢神经系统炎症性疾病。不同疾病的靶点、细胞类型和病理环境存在差异，也意味着递送平台需要针对具体药物和适应症进行适配。虽然诺华停止项目的具体原因并未公开，但可以观察到的是，平台型Biotech的竞争逻辑正在发生变化。早期交易数量和首付款能够反映市场对技术的兴趣，但真正决定平台长期价值的，是能否持续生成候选药物，并在人体中证明其递送能力。 content: 首页 资讯 摩熵原创 时讯 先声药业拿下凌科药业泽普昔替尼皮肤科独家商业化权益，国产JAK1抑制剂特应性皮炎NDA获受理 先声药业拿下凌科药业泽普昔替尼皮肤科独家商业化权益，国产JAK1抑制剂特应性皮炎NDA获受理 张鹏 · 新药研发分析师 张 张鹏 新药研发分析师 审核：王正晴 · 药学博士 关注全球创新药研发管线、临床试验进展与注册审批动态；重点分析热门靶点、临床价值与管线竞争格局。累计发布研发分析 102+ 篇。 15小时前 731 先声药业集团有限公司 凌科药业（浙江）股份有限公司 JAK1抑制剂 泽普昔替尼在 中重度特应性皮炎 11月2日，先声药业发布公告，宣布与凌科药业（浙江）股份有限公司达成新一轮合作，获得选择性JAK1抑制剂泽普昔替尼在中国大陆及港澳台地区，用于成人中重度特应性皮炎及其他皮肤科适应症的独家商业化权益。图源：先声药业企业公告这是双方继2022年3月首次合作后的再次携手。此前，先声药业已获得泽普昔替尼治疗类风湿关节炎、强直性脊柱炎两大适应症的大中华区独家商业化权益。本次合作进一步将商业化布局拓展至皮肤科领域。值得关注的是，泽普昔替尼治疗中重度特应性皮炎的关键性Ⅲ期临床研究已完成，相关新药上市申请（NDA）于2026年4月获国家药监局药品审评中心（CDE）受理。一、二度合作，商业化权益再扩容泽普昔替尼由凌科药业自主研发，是一款高选择性、口服第二代JAK1抑制剂，正在开发用于类风湿关节炎、特应性皮炎及强直性脊柱炎等炎症和自身免疫性疾病。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库此次合作是双方2022年首次合作后的进一步扩容。先声药业在原有风湿免疫适应症商业化权益基础上，新增获得泽普昔替尼在特应性皮炎及其他皮肤科适应症的独家商业化权益。摩熵医药数据库显示，目前，JAK3抑制剂SIM-0280也在布局自身免疫性疾病领域，尚处于临床前研究阶段。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库对于先声药业而言，此次合作有望进一步丰富自身免疫领域产品组合，并利用现有商业化体系推进产品市场开发；对于凌科药业而言，则可以借助先声药业的商业化能力，为产品后续上市及市场推广提供支持。双方此次合作的具体交易金额、里程碑付款及销售分成比例尚未披露。二、III期临床完成，特应性皮炎上市申请获受理临床数据方面，泽普昔替尼治疗中重度特应性皮炎的Ⅲ期研究共纳入356例患者。结果显示，治疗第16周时，两个剂量组在EASI-75、vIGA-AD 0/1及瘙痒改善等终点上均显著优于安慰剂组。起效时间方面，给药后第1天即可观察到瘙痒改善，第2周开始出现皮损改善。安全性方面，不良事件以轻中度为主，严重不良事件和特别关注不良事件发生率与安慰剂组基本相当，未发现新的安全性信号。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库除特应性皮炎外，泽普昔替尼治疗类风湿关节炎的Ⅲ期临床研究已完成，针对强直性脊柱炎的Ⅲ期临床开发项目仍在进行中。目前，特应性皮炎领域已有度普利尤单抗等生物制剂，以及乌帕替尼、阿布昔替尼等口服JAK抑制剂。泽普昔替尼未来若顺利获批，仍需面对较为充分的市场竞争，其疗效、安全性及长期用药表现将成为影响市场竞争力的重要因素。从首次合作到权益扩容，先声药业与凌科药业进一步深化泽普昔替尼的商业化合作。随着特应性皮炎适应症进入上市申请审评阶段，这款国产口服JAK1抑制剂的后续进展值得关注。参考来源：[1] title: 益方生物TYK2抑制剂Nomelcitinib银屑病III期成功，多自身免疫适应症同步推进
content: 首页 资讯 摩熵原创 时讯 益方生物TYK2抑制剂Nomelcitinib银屑病III期成功，多自身免疫适应症同步推进 益方生物TYK2抑制剂Nomelcitinib银屑病III期成功，多自身免疫适应症同步推进 张鹏 · 新药研发分析师 张 张鹏 新药研发分析师 审核：王正晴 · 药学博士 关注全球创新药研发管线、临床试验进展与注册审批动态；重点分析热门靶点、临床价值与管线竞争格局。累计发布研发分析 102+ 篇。 16小时前 1077 益方生物科技（上海）股份有限公司 Nomelcitinib TYK2抑制剂 银屑病 III期临床研究 11月2日，益方生物宣布，自主研发的TYK2抑制剂 Nomelcitinib（D-2570）治疗中重度斑块状银屑病的注册性III期临床研究达到主要终点和关键次要终点。图源：益方生物企业公告研究结果显示，该药治疗第16周时PASI 90达标率超过70%，PGA 0/1达标率超过80%，且治疗第4周就已显示出显著疗效。这意味着Nomelcitinib在银屑病领域的临床开发取得重要进展。一、III期研究成功，起效仅需4周Nomelcitinib是益方生物自主研发的一款新型口服选择性TYK2抑制剂，通过选择性结合TYK2假激酶域（JH2），抑制TYK2激酶活性，阻断TYK2依赖性的细胞因子信号传导，从而参与免疫调节。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库此次III期研究是一项多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照临床试验，共纳入391例中重度斑块状银屑病患者，旨在评价Nomelcitinib的有效性和安全性。研究主要终点为治疗第16周时达到PASI 90（银屑病面积与严重程度指数较基线改善至少90%）的患者比例；关键次要终点为达到PGA 0/1（皮损完全清除或几乎完全清除，且较基线下降至少2分）的患者比例。结果显示，治疗第16周时，两个Nomelcitinib治疗组的PASI 90达标率均超过70%，PGA 0/1达标率均超过80%，两项指标均显著优于安慰剂组。值得关注的是，Nomelcitinib起效较快。治疗第4周时，两个治疗组达到PASI 90和PGA 0/1的患者比例便已显著高于安慰剂组，且随着治疗时间延长，疗效进一步提升。在其他次要疗效终点分析中，Nomelcitinib治疗组同样优于安慰剂组，差异具有统计学意义。安全性方面，Nomelcitinib整体表现出良好的安全性和耐受性，其安全性特征与既往II期临床研究及其他选择性TYK2 JH2抑制剂相似，未发现新的安全性信号。二、多适应症布局持续推进，临床数据展现竞争潜力此次III期研究结果与此前II期研究数据保持高度一致，进一步支持了Nomelcitinib在银屑病领域的开发潜力。除此次注册性III期研究外，益方生物还在推进Nomelcitinib与氘可来昔替尼头对头比较的银屑病III期临床试验，以进一步评价其有效性和安全性。在其他适应症方面，公司正在开展Nomelcitinib治疗中重度活动性溃疡性结肠炎（UC）、银屑病关节炎（PsA）、系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）及白癜风等疾病的II期临床试验，同时也在美国开展该药治疗银屑病的II期临床试验。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库从已披露的临床数据来看，Nomelcitinib的疗效指标也展现出一定竞争力。以治疗第16周的PASI 90和PGA/IGA 0/1达标率为例，IL-23R拮抗剂伊可白滞素在三项III期研究中的相关数据如下：ICONIC-LEAD研究：第16周PASI 90达标率为49.6%，IGA 0/1达标率为64.7%。ICONIC-ADVANCE 1研究：第16周PASI 90达标率为55%，IGA 0/1达标率为68%。ICONIC-ADVANCE 2研究：第16周PASI 90达标率为57%，IGA 0/1达标率为70%。相比之下，Nomelcitinib两个治疗组的PASI 90达标率均超过70%，PGA 0/1达标率均超过80%，数值上高于上述伊可白滞素研究结果。需要注意的是，上述数据来自不同临床试验，研究设计、入组人群及评价标准可能存在差异，不能直接等同于头对头疗效比较。从研发进展来看，Nomelcitinib已从银屑病II期研究推进至注册性III期阶段，同时围绕多种自身免疫及炎症性疾病开展临床探索。随着银屑病头对头III期研究及其他适应症研究持续推进，其后续临床数据和开发进展值得关注。 全球医药行业每日重点资讯企业动态11月2日，费森尤斯卡比中国宣布，张宁先生正式加入公司，担任北京费森尤斯卡比医药有限公司总经理、费森尤斯卡比中国副总裁，向费森尤斯卡比中国区总裁兼董事长张巍汇报。张宁在医药行业拥有超过20年从业经历，加入费森尤斯卡比之前，他在GSK担任副总裁、特药事业部负责人，主导了肿瘤业务的建立，领导免疫、抗感染、HIV、肿瘤等领域创新药物在中国市场的引入与可及性。更早之前，张宁曾任恒瑞医药市场总经理。临床后期生物制药公司OncoC4, Inc.宣布任命Dan Janiak博士为首席商务官。 Dan在肿瘤学、神经学和罕见病领域的生物技术公司创建、融资和规模化发展方面拥有超过15年的经验。他最近担任AstraZeneca业务发展执行总监。在加入AstraZeneca之前，Dan曾担任Trotana Therapeutics的总裁兼首席运营官。在加入Trotana之前，Dan是Taysha Gene Therapies的第一位员工。在职业生涯的早期，Dan曾在VelosBio和AveXis担任战略和企业发展职务。东北制药发布人事变动公告。因工作调整，蔡永刚辞去公司董事、总经理等职务，辞职后继续在公司任职；黄成仁辞去公司董事等职务，离开公司。仁和药业股份有限公司于深交所发布《关于董事、副董事长辞职的公告》，披露董事会于 10 月 26 日下午收到公司董事、副董事长肖正连提交的书面辞职报告，因达到退休年龄原因，辞去公司董事、副董事长，董事会战略委员会、审计委员会、薪酬与考核委员会委员职务，辞去上述职务后不再担任公司任何职务。联影医疗公布，打算在巴西圣卡塔琳娜州若因维利市建设其在拉美地区第一个智能制造工厂，项目总共投入5.35亿雷亚尔（约人民币6.55亿），主要制造磁共振设备以及肿瘤放射治疗方面的高端医疗装备。作为联影医疗拉美首个智能制造工厂，项目总投资为5.35亿雷亚尔，计划厂房面积大概8000平方米，核心业务是生产磁共振设备和肿瘤放疗相关高端装备。艾可蓝控股子公司十方云（上海）科技有限公司与江苏恒瑞医药股份有限公司签署战略合作协议。双方将围绕AI赋能医药创新与全生命周期患者价值，建立长期战略合作关系。上海英捷信医疗科技有限公司宣布完成2亿元人民币B轮融资。本轮融资由中金资本旗下基金领投，珠海科技产业集团、基石资本、启明创投、厚新健投及映月基金跟投，老股东光合创投持续投资。本轮融资资金将主要用于进一步提升全球化规模生产与交付能力，加快新一代自我给药装置的研发及产业化，并持续推进海外产品注册、市场拓展及全球客户服务体系建设。10月29日，Merit Medical Systems, Inc.（麦瑞通）宣布完成对Solo Pace, Inc.的收购，对价约4500万美元（折合人民币近3亿元）。2023年1月至2025年12月，麦瑞通分多次向Solo Pace投入资金共500万美元，拿到Solo Pace约18%的股权、一项挂钩商业化里程碑的全额收购期权以及产品上市后的独家分销权。本次收购交割已在10月13日完成。本次收购Solo Pace将进一步完善其商业版图，强化公司在结构性心脏病领域的市场地位。CDMO企业Cambrex耗资1.2亿美元的爱荷华州查尔斯城工厂扩建项目破土动工。扩建将增加16万升的制造能力，使该基地的总产能增加约25％，达到近一百万升，为小分子活性药物成分（API）和合成肽的开发和商业化生产提供支持。该项目预计将于2028年第四季度完成。Aspen Neuroscience宣布首次公开募股（IPO）定价，预计募集资金总额约1.406亿美元。Aspen Neuroscience的核心研发方向是利用诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）技术开发自体细胞疗法，治疗帕金森病等神经退行性疾病。生物技术公司Setara Biosciences宣布完成9000万美元A轮融资。该公司核心管线STAR-0871是一款潜在“first-in-class”口服TRPV4抑制剂，拟用于治疗腓骨肌萎缩症2C型（CMT2C）和膀胱过度活动症。阿斯利康(AstraZeneca)公布2026年第三季度业绩。季度总营收162.09亿美元，上年同期为151.91亿美元，同比增长7%。季度营业利润43.87亿美元，上年同期为35.83亿美元，同比增长22%。季度税后利润31.16亿美元，上年同期为25.35亿美元，同比增长23%。法国制药企业赛诺菲集团(Sanofi)公布2026年第三季度业绩。季度净销售额144.44亿欧元，上年同期为124.34亿欧元。季度营业利润43.49亿欧元，上年同期为36.23亿欧元。季度归属公司股东的净利润30.21亿欧元，上年同期为28.02亿欧元。艾伯维(AbbVie)公布2026年第三季度业绩。季度净营收174.04亿美元，上年同期为157.76亿美元。季度营业利润62.67亿美元，上年同期为19.04亿美元。季度归属公司的净利润42.18亿美元，上年同期为1.86亿美元。吉利德科学(Gilead Sciences)公布2026年第三季度业绩。季度总营收83亿美元，上年同期为77.69亿美元。季度营业利润34.62亿美元，上年同期为33.27亿美元。季度净利润24.29亿美元，上年同期为30.52亿美元。产业动态凌科药业宣布，与先声药业就自主研发的高选择性、口服第二代 JAK1 抑制剂泽普昔替尼（zemprocitinib）进一步拓展商业化合作。根据合作安排，先声药业将获得泽普昔替尼在成人中重度特应性皮炎及其他皮肤科适应症在中国大陆及港澳台地区的独家商业化权益。可孚医疗推出飞利浦红外线耳温计6000系列，集精准测温、分龄判定、夜间模式、无耳套免耗材设计、适老化交互于一体。内置多重技术保障：开机自动预热探头，可抵消环境温差对测量结果的影响，确保数值稳定不漂移；抖动提示功能，引导用户调整操作，减少无效测量。年龄段选择功能可智能匹配对应人群的发烧判定阈值，让测温结果更具科学参考性；搭载一键开启夜间模式，采用免耳套精准测量技术，终身零耗材。先健科技旗下子公司元心科技(深圳)有限公司自主研发的IBS可吸收药物洗脱冠脉支架系统（IBS冠脉支架）获得欧盟CE MDR认证。该产品为全球首个获得销售许可的铁基可吸收冠脉支架系统，标志着铁基生物可吸收材料技术在冠脉介入领域取得关键监管突破。优锐医药宣布，在中国开展的用于治疗尘螨相关过敏性鼻炎的STG320在REACH III期临床试验中完成首例试验参与者首次给药。该款含片型药物在其原研公司Stallergenes Greer的名称为Actair。目前Actair已在21个国家和地区实现商业化，更多市场拓展工作正在进行中。联系美通社+86-10-5953 9500info@prnasia.com title: AstraZeneca Taps insitro AI for MASH in Deal Worth Up to $1.5 Billion
content: Advertisement News|Articles|October 15, 2026 AstraZeneca Taps insitro AI for MASH in Deal Worth Up to $1.5 Billion Author(s)Pharmaceutical Executive Editorial Staff AstraZeneca will pay insitro $40 million upfront to apply AI to target discovery in MASH and cardiomyopathies, with no candidates named yet. Advertisement AstraZeneca has signed a drug discovery collaboration and licensing agreement with insitro to apply artificial intelligence (AI) to target identification and therapeutic design in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) and cardiomyopathies, the companies announced Oct. 15.1,2 Insitro will receive $40 million upfront and is eligible for up to approximately $1.46 billion in milestones.1,2Sharon Barr, executive vice president and head of BioPharmaceuticals research and development at AstraZeneca, tied the agreement to target selection: “We know that disease biology is incredibly complex, and one of the most critical decisions in R&D is selecting the right target. This strategic collaboration underscores our commitment to maximizing the potential of cutting-edge AI to tackle the root cause of disease. Partnering with insitro, we will use advanced AI to identify the biological drivers of disease to support the rapid discovery of high-quality novel targets, advancing our ambition to deliver the next generation of medicines to patients faster.”1“MASH and cardiomyopathies are prevalent, underdiagnosed diseases where high-content data holds immense potential for uncovering disease drivers. By applying AI to these complex datasets, we can unlock greater discovery power and reveal novel genetic insights.”What are AstraZeneca and insitro agreeing to do?Insitro will use its Virtual Human platform to identify causal disease biology in both indications and advance AstraZeneca-nominated targets from discovery to development candidate.1,2 The platform combines large-scale human and cellular data with AI-enabled target identification and medicine design.1AstraZeneca will take the clinical development and regulatory work and holds exclusive worldwide rights to the selected programs; insitro’s release adds that AstraZeneca will also lead commercialization.1,2Beyond the upfront payment, insitro is eligible for single-digit royalties on global sales.1,2 The two releases describe the milestones slightly differently: AstraZeneca cites development and commercial milestones, while insitro includes discovery milestones.1,2The upfront payment represents less than 3% of the combined headline value, and neither company disclosed the number of targets, program timelines or payment schedule.Why are MASH and cardiomyopathies difficult to treat?Insitro’s release says each disease is defined by heterogeneity, with a single diagnostic label covering patients whose underlying biology differs, which has complicated treatment.2 (()=>{var l=(n,t)=>{let i=async()=>{await(await n())()},e=typeof t.value=="object"?t.value:void 0,s={timeout:e==null?void 0:e.timeout};"requestIdleCallback"in window?window.requestIdleCallback(i,s):setTimeout(i,s.timeout||200)};(self.Astro||(self.Astro={})).idle=l;window.dispatchEvent(new Event("astro:idle"));})(); Daphne Koller, Ph.D., founder and CEO of insitro, said: “MASH and cardiomyopathies are prevalent, underdiagnosed diseases where high-content data holds immense potential for uncovering disease drivers. By applying AI to these complex datasets, we can unlock greater discovery power and reveal novel genetic insights. Our platform simultaneously deconvolutes disease biology and identifies causal drivers of disease pathologies. Partnering with AstraZeneca allows us to pair our deep biological precision with their pharmaceutical expertise and scale with potential for accelerated advancement of novel programs through development and to patients.”2In MASH, the treatment landscape has changed recently. The FDA approved resmetirom (Rezdiffra) in March 2024 under its accelerated approval pathway for adults with noncirrhotic disease and moderate to advanced liver scarring, to be used with diet and exercise. The agency, which at the time referred to the condition as nonalcoholic steatohepatitis, said patients had previously lacked a medication that directly addressed their liver damage, and cited an estimate of 6 million to 8 million U.S. patients at that disease stage.3The cardiomyopathy picture is less defined in the releases, which do not specify which forms are in scope. Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, the most common inherited cardiovascular disorder, is estimated to affect 1 in 500 people, and a published review notes that existing studies may have underestimated its prevalence.4 That offers one illustration of the underdiagnosis Koller describes, though it should not be read as the collaboration’s target population.How does the collaboration fit each company’s portfolio?AstraZeneca describes cardiovascular, renal and metabolism as one of its main disease areas and a key growth driver, with an emphasis on the links among the heart, kidneys, liver and pancreas.1 A program spanning a liver disease and heart muscle diseases fits within that framing.Insitro says it has built a multimodal corpus of human and cellular data since 2018 and is advancing nine programs, including genetic regulators of liver fat and fibrosis expected to enter the clinic in early 2027.2 The company reports more than $750 million in capital and existing collaborations with Bristol Myers Squibb, Lilly and Gilead.2 The release does not say how its internal liver programs relate to targets AstraZeneca will nominate.What remains unknown about the collaboration?No candidate, efficacy data or safety data accompany the announcement, and the collaboration sits at the discovery stage. Targets identified through AI-driven analysis of human data will still need validation through preclinical work and clinical trials, where heterogeneity of disease could also affect trial design. Milestone and royalty figures are potential payments contingent on progress that neither company has timed publicly. Neither release addresses market reaction, and independent verification of the platform’s performance in these indications was not available at the time of publication.SourcesAstraZeneca announces new strategic collaboration with insitro to use advanced AI systems to develop transformative therapeutics for difficult to treat cardiometabolic diseases. title: STAT Plus: Coming readout of Kymera eczema trial is a high-stakes moment in a bid to rival Dupixent
content: STAT PlusBiotech Coming readout of Kymera eczema trial is a high-stakes moment in a bid to rival Dupixent Biotech aspires to turn pill into a therapy for multiple immunology and inflammatory disorders Manage alerts for this article Save this story for later Share this article Adobe By Jonathan WosenNov. 2, 2026 West Coast Biotech & Life Sciences Reporter Jonathan Wosen[email protected]Jonathan Wosen is STAT’s West Coast biotech & life sciences reporter. You can reach Jonathan on Signal at jwosen.27. Over the past decade, Sanofi and Regeneron’s Dupixent has become the top-selling drug in immunology, bringing in tens of billions in revenue while transforming outcomes for the 1.4 million patients currently on the therapy for conditions including eczema, asthma, and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. But investors and doctors are intensely following an experimental therapy positioned to rival the pharma blockbuster, with results from a key study fast approaching. Massachusetts biotech Kymera Therapeutics plans to announce data from a mid-stage clinical trial of its lead asset, KT-621, in eczema before the end of the year. Market analysts for the investment bank Jefferies, using common shorthand for immunology and inflammatory disorders, have called the upcoming results “one of the most impactful I&I readouts this year.” Advertisement Success (or failure) could have major consequences for Kymera, its growing list of competitors, and the millions of people who live with eczema in the United States. The results could also bolster or dampen the biotech’s aspirations to treat a broader class of immunological diseases with its drug, including chronic spontaneous urticaria and asthma. Analysts forecast that the drug’s sales could reach nearly $4 billion by 2035, including more than $3 billion in eczema revenue, according to Visible Alpha. title: Karyopharm Enters Chapter 11 in Planned Merger With Ayrmid
content: Advertisement News|Articles|November 3, 2026 Karyopharm Enters Chapter 11 in Planned Merger With Ayrmid Author(s)Pharmaceutical Executive Editorial Staff Karyopharm filed for Chapter 11 under a plan to merge with Ayrmid, with competing bids allowed and closing targeted for the first quarter of 2027. Advertisement Karyopharm Therapeutics, the maker of the multiple myeloma treatment Xpovio (selinexor), filed for Chapter 11 protection on Nov. 2 under a restructuring support agreement that provides for a merger with Ayrmid, the parent company of Gamida Cell.1 The plan would convert roughly $276 million of funded debt into a majority stake in the combined company and cancel existing common and preferred shares without a distribution.2The company will seek court approval of bidding procedures that allow other parties to submit competing offers, with closing expected in the first quarter of 2027.1 “Following a comprehensive review of available alternatives, we believe this process provides a clear framework to pursue a value maximizing transaction for our stakeholders while continuing our important work of advancing therapies for patients with multiple myeloma and myelofibrosis,” said Richard Paulson, president and CEO of Karyopharm.1Key FactsDeal: Ayrmid merger through Chapter 11 planLead bidder: Ayrmid; rival bids allowedDebtor-in-possession financing: up to $55MDebt holders to receive 55% of combined companyExisting shareholders: no distributionProduct: Xpovio (selinexor), exportin 1 inhibitorTarget close: first quarter of 2027“We see considerable potential in Karyopharm’s marketed products, development pipeline and experienced team, and believe that, together, we can build a broader, stronger commercial-stage hematology business with meaningful opportunities for future growth.” — Dr. Joe Wiley, chairman and chief executive officer of AyrmidWhat are the proposed merger terms?Under the plan described in Karyopharm’s disclosure statement, which the court has not yet approved, creditors holding the roughly $276 million of funded debt would receive 55% of the combined company’s common stock, along with contingent value rights tied to future Xpovio sales in myelofibrosis.2 Ayrmid’s existing equity holders would receive the remaining 45% and contingent equity tied to future revenue from its product Omisirge.2 The combined company would emerge with no more than $135 million of funded debt, a reduction of about $141 million, and Karyopharm’s common stock is expected to be delisted from Nasdaq.2Karyopharm has secured commitments for up to $55 million in debtor-in-possession financing from existing secured lenders, which, with cash from operations, is expected to support the business during the case once the court approves it.1 The company says it expects ordinary operations and partnerships to continue without disruption.1 The market test remains open: if a rival bid meets conditions that include at least $335 million in net proceeds at closing, the company may pursue a sale instead of the merger.2Why did Karyopharm file for Chapter 11?The disclosure statement attributes the filing to sustained operating losses and a reliance on capital markets that depended on clinical progress.2 When two phase 3 readouts in 2026 fell short of expectations and liquidity tightened, secured creditors agreed to payment deferrals and forbearances.2 A formal sale process launched in July 2026 drew multiple proposals, none of which was actionable before the company exhausted its liquidity, according to the filing.2 Ayrmid’s proposal emerged from that process.2 (()=>{var l=(n,t)=>{let i=async()=>{await(await n())()},e=typeof show?Xpovio is an oral exportin 1 inhibitor that Karyopharm markets in the United States for adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.1 In the randomized, open-label phase 3 BOSTON trial of 402 previously treated patients, once-weekly selinexor with bortezomib and dexamethasone produced median progression-free survival of 13.93 months, compared with 9.46 months for twice-weekly bortezomib and dexamethasone (hazard ratio, 0.70).3 Grade 3 or 4 thrombocytopenia occurred in 39% of patients receiving selinexor and 17% in the control arm.3 Myelofibrosis is the company’s other stated priority. In the phase 3 SENTRY trial of 353 patients, 50% of those given selinexor plus ruxolitinib reached a spleen volume reduction of at least 35% at week 24, versus 28% with ruxolitinib alone, but the groups did not differ significantly on the symptom-score co-primary endpoint, according to company-reported topline results.4 Grade 3 or higher adverse events occurred in 70% of patients on the combination and 50% on ruxolitinib alone.4 Karyopharm submitted a supplemental new drug application seeking accelerated approval on Aug. 31, 2026.2How does the merger fit hematology commercial strategy?Ayrmid markets two FDA-approved products in the United States: Omisirge (omidubicel-onlv), a cell therapy for certain hematologic malignancies and severe aplastic anemia, and Aphexda (motixafortide), which mobilizes hematopoietic stem cells in adults with multiple myeloma.1 Multiple myeloma is the point at which the two companies’ marketed products overlap. “We see a strong strategic fit between Ayrmid and Karyopharm, with complementary portfolios, established commercial capabilities and a shared commitment to addressing significant unmet needs in hematology,” said Dr. Joe Wiley, chairman and chief executive officer of Ayrmid.1What risks and open questions remain?The plan still requires court confirmation. Holders of all claims entitled to vote have agreed to support it, according to the filing, so uncertainty centers on court approval, rival bids and regulatory reviews.2 Creditor voting closes Nov. 30, and the company has asked for a hearing on Jan. 11, 2027.2 Antitrust and foreign investment reviews are under evaluation, while FDA approval of the transaction itself is not expected to be required.2Projections for the combined company will be filed later with a plan supplement, so the commercial case remains unquantified.2 No FDA decision on the myelofibrosis application is reported in the sources reviewed, and SENTRY’s mixed result leaves that program’s regulatory outcome unsettled.2SourcesKaryopharm Therapeutics Inc. announces planned merger with Ayrmid Ltd. to strengthen company for the future. title: 石药集团牵手康方生物：B7-H3 ADC SYS6043联合PD-1/VEGF双抗依沃西，国内联合疗法临床正式启动
content: 首页 资讯 摩熵原创 时讯 石药集团牵手康方生物：B7-H3 ADC SYS6043联合PD-1/VEGF双抗依沃西，国内联合疗法临床正式启动 石药集团牵手康方生物：B7-H3 ADC SYS6043联合PD-1/VEGF双抗依沃西，国内联合疗法临床正式启动 张鹏 · 新药研发分析师 张 张鹏 新药研发分析师 审核：王正晴 · 药学博士 关注全球创新药研发管线、临床试验进展与注册审批动态；重点分析热门靶点、临床价值与管线竞争格局。累计发布研发分析 102+ 篇。 15小时前 942 石药集团 康方生物 B7-H3 ADC SYS6043 PD-1/VEGF双抗 依沃西注射液 11月2日，石药集团与康方生物宣布达成临床合作，双方将围绕石药自主研发的B7-H3 ADC（SYS6043）与康方PD-1/VEGF双抗依沃西注射液开展联合开发，合作区域为中国大陆，相关临床试验成果由双方共同所有。图源：石药集团企业官微ADC与免疫疗法联合开发并不新鲜，但此次合作有一个值得关注的细节：石药选择的不是传统PD-1单抗，而是同时靶向PD-1和VEGF的双抗依沃西。这也释放出一个信号：随着ADC联合疗法不断推进，PD-1/VEGF双抗正成为创新药企业探索ADC联合治疗的新选择。一、B7-H3 ADC联手PD-1/VEGF双抗SYS6043由石药巨石生物自主研发，是一款靶向B7-H3的新一代ADC，采用拓扑异构酶I抑制剂作为载荷，DAR约为6，采用Fcγ受体效应沉默设计以降低脱靶毒性，具有可裂解连接子和旁观者效应。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库临床数据方面，2026年ESMO公布的乳腺癌队列数据显示，在139例患者中，TNBC、HR+/HER2-及HER2+亚组的确认客观缓解率（ORR）分别达到75.0%、53.7%和69.6%；3级及以上治疗期间不良事件发生率为28.8%，间质性肺病发生率为1.4%。此外，2026年ASCO公布的全瘤种I/II期研究数据显示，533例可评估患者整体ORR为41.8%，其中肺癌和乳腺癌亚组ORR分别为46.3%和56.8%。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库此次合作的另一款药——依沃西，是康方生物自主研发的PD-1/VEGF双特异性抗体，目前已获批3项适应症。在临床研究中，依沃西已展现出一定的头对头竞争优势。例如，HARMONi-6研究中，依沃西联合化疗一线治疗鳞状非小细胞肺癌，中位总生存期（mOS）达到27.9个月，对照组为23.7个月；HARMONi-2研究中，依沃西单药一线治疗PD-L1阳性非小细胞肺癌，mOS达到30.8个月，对照组为22.6个月。值得注意的是，此次石药选择依沃西作为SYS6043的联合开发搭档，而非简单采用传统PD-1单抗，也让这笔合作有了更多值得关注的地方。二、ADC联合疗法，竞争逻辑正在变化为什么PD-1/VEGF双抗开始受到ADC研发企业关注？传统PD-1抑制剂主要通过解除T细胞的免疫抑制状态发挥作用，而VEGF除了促进肿瘤血管生成，还参与肿瘤免疫微环境的调节。因此，PD-1/VEGF双抗能够同时作用于免疫检查点和VEGF通路，有望改善肿瘤免疫微环境，为ADC联合治疗提供新的协同思路。简单来说，ADC负责靶向递送细胞毒载荷、杀伤肿瘤细胞，VEGF阻断有望改善免疫抑制微环境，PD-1阻断则帮助恢复T细胞抗肿瘤活性。三种作用机制存在潜在互补性。这一方向已经吸引多家药企布局。康方生物此前披露，阿斯利康、GSK、辉瑞、吉利德等跨国药企，以及国内多家ADC企业，均已开展核心ADC产品与依沃西的联合疗法探索。此外，BNT324/DB-1311联合PD-L1/VEGF双抗Pumitamig，以及科伦博泰B7-H3 ADC SKB500联合自研PD-1/VEGF双抗SKB118，也在推进相关联合治疗探索。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库这意味着，ADC与PD-1/VEGF双抗的联合开发正在成为值得关注的研发方向。对于康方生物而言，依沃西与多家ADC企业建立合作，有望进一步拓展其联合治疗布局，积累不同靶点、不同瘤种的临床数据。对于石药集团而言，此次合作则为SYS6043增加了一种新的联合治疗开发路径。从单一药物研发到联合治疗探索，ADC赛道的竞争正在延伸至联合搭档的选择。依沃西能否凭借已有临床数据和不断扩大的合作网络，形成差异化竞争优势，仍有待后续临床研究验证。 title: STAT Plus: FDA OKs generic HIV prevention shot, widening access for lower-income countries
content: STAT PlusPharmalot FDA OKs generic HIV prevention shot, widening access for lower-income countries The annual cost per person will be $40, comparable to daily tablets Manage alerts for this article Save this story for later Share this article A pharmacist holds a vial of the HIV prevention medicine lenacapavir in Cape Town, South Africa.Nardus Engelbrecht/AP By Ed SilvermanNov. 2, 2026 Pharmalot Columnist, Senior Writer Ed Silverman[email protected]Ed’s stories explore prescription drug pricing, affordability and access, as well issues surrounding patents, litigation, and legislation. He is also the author of the morning Pharmalittle newsletter and the afternoon Pharmalot newsletter. After months of anticipation, the Food and Drug Administration gave tentative approval to Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories to make a generic version of a groundbreaking HIV prevention medicine, a key step in widening access for dozens of low- and middle-income countries. The company, one of the world’s largest generic drugmakers, plans to start shipping the medicine next month as part of an effort propelled, in part, by several global health organizations to ensure the drug becomes available in lower-income countries as quickly as possible. The annual cost per person will be $40, comparable to daily tablets.Advertisement Known as lenacapavir, the injectable drug is widely seen as a game-changing tool for eradicating HIV because it offers virtually complete protection against contracting the virus with just one administration every six months. The brand-name version, which is known as Yetzugo in the U.S., is marketed by Gilead Sciences and was approved by the FDA last year. STAT+ Exclusive Story Already have an account? 2026/10/30 4573 炎症性肠病 Boehringer Ingelheim Fremont Inc 嘉兴安帝康生物科技有限公司 江苏先声医药科技有限公司 玛氘诺沙韦 10月28日，据国家药监局官网显示，嘉兴安帝康生物与先声药业合作开发的1类抗流感创新药玛氘诺沙韦片收到药品通知件，即未能获批上市。图源：NMPA官网玛氘诺沙韦是国内备受关注的抗流感创新药之一。该药最初由安帝康生物自主研发，2023年10月，先声药业与安帝康达成独家合作，获得其在中国地区流感适应症的独家商业化权益。此次上市申报未能顺利推进，也让这款曾被寄予期待的国产抗流感新药，再次成为行业关注的焦点。一、玛氘诺沙韦用药疗程短，单次口服1粒玛氘诺沙韦是一款具有全球自主知识产权的抗流感创新药，属于Cap依赖型核酸内切酶抑制剂。其通过抑制流感病毒Cap依赖型核酸内切酶活性，阻断病毒mRNA转录，从而抑制病毒复制。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库在用药方式上，玛氘诺沙韦的一大特点是疗程短。相关资料显示，成人患者全程仅需单次口服1粒即可完成治疗。相较于需要多次给药的部分抗流感药物，这种给药方式有望提升用药便利性和患者依从性。摩熵医药数据库显示，玛氘诺沙韦于2021年首次申请临床，2025年3月首次申请上市，涉及甲型流感病毒、乙型流感病毒相关适应症。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库从研发到商业化合作，再到上市申请，玛氘诺沙韦的进展也折射出国内抗流感创新药研发的持续推进。二、国产流感新药竞争持续升温玛氘诺沙韦的上市申报遇阻，也让国产抗流感药物的竞争格局再次受到关注。摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库显示，截至目前，国内已有10款流行性感冒新药获批上市。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库2025年便密集迎来了太景生物科技的玛帕西沙韦、征祥医药的玛硒洛沙韦、广东众生药业的昂拉地韦、银杏树药业的玛舒拉沙韦4款国产新药的密集获批上市，让国产抗流感药物正全面驶入爆发期。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库2026年8月13日，上海爱科百发生物医药技术股份有限公司宣布，其自主研发的首款抗流感Fc偶联物（AFC）新药AK0406注射液，用于流感预防适应症的临床试验申请正式获得国家药监局批准。这是中国首个进入临床阶段的流感AFC药物，填补了国内长效抗病毒流感预防领域的技术空白。三、结语随着更多创新药和改良型新药陆续推进，流感治疗领域的竞争正逐渐延伸至作用机制、给药方式及临床应用场景等多个维度。对玛氘诺沙韦而言，后续审评进展及商业化前景仍值得关注。参考来源：[1] Kemny/Science Photo Library By Elaine ChenOct. 27, 2026 National Biotech Reporter Elaine Chen[email protected]Elaine’s stories explore the boom in new obesity treatments, new drug payment models, the ways companies are affected by FDA changes, and the emerging psychedelics drug sector. She co-writes The Readout newsletter, and co-hosts STAT’s weekly biotech podcast, The Readout Loud. You can reach Elaine on Signal at elaineywchen.70. Artiva Biotherapeutics said Tuesday that it’s winding down after two patients died in a trial testing its cell therapy for autoimmune diseases, the latest in a series of safety events that have emerged in a promising research field. One participant in the Phase 2 study died from a neurological complication after receiving the treatment, an NK cell therapy. Researchers determined the death was likely not related to the cell therapy itself, but to a chemotherapy that was given before the cell therapy, Artiva said. It’s standard to give patients chemotherapies before infusing cell therapies to lower the patients’ white blood cell count and make room for the new cells.Advertisement Related Story STAT Plus: Patient dies in Bristol Myers Squibb autoimmune CAR-T trial A second participant experienced sudden death about two months after treatment. Researchers determined that this was not related to any component of the treatment process, but the cause of death has not been determined, the San Diego-based company said. title: Your Questions Answered: Foundayo’s EU Panel Backing, Enspryng for TED, Gilead’s Masked TCE Bet, FDA’s Rare Disease Overhaul, and More
content: Advertisement News|Articles|October 19, 2026 Your Questions Answered: Foundayo’s EU Panel Backing, Enspryng for TED, Gilead’s Masked TCE Bet, FDA’s Rare Disease Overhaul, and More Foundayo’s EU backing, Enspryng for TED, Gilead’s masked TCE deal, FDA’s rare disease reset, and Bausch + Lomb’s new interim CEO — explained. Advertisement Lilly’s Foundayo Receives Positive CHMP Opinion for EuropeWhat did the EMA committee recommend?The European Medicines Agency’s Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use recommended granting marketing authorization in the EU for Foundayo (orforglipron) for two indications: weight management in adults with obesity or overweight, and the treatment of type 2 diabetes in adults whose blood glucose is not adequately controlled. The European Commission makes the final approval decision and typically follows CHMP recommendations within a few weeks.What is Foundayo and why does it matter?Foundayo is Eli Lilly’s oral GLP-1 receptor agonist — a once-daily pill that can be taken at any time of day without food and water restrictions. That last point distinguishes it from other oral GLP-1 therapies currently on the market. The drug received FDA approval for obesity in April 2026 and launched commercially in the United States in the second quarter. Lilly has submitted orforglipron for regulatory review in approximately 40 markets globally.The Stories Covered in this PieceEMA Panel Backs Lilly’s Foundayo for Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes in EuropeFDA Approves Enspryng (Satralizumab) for Thyroid Eye DiseaseAstraZeneca Taps insitro AI for MASH in Deal Worth Up to $1.5 BillionFDA Launches Rare Disease Framework InitiativeVir Biotechnology Enters R&D Collaboration with Gilead for Three Novel PRO-XTEN Dual Masked T-Cell EngagersBausch + Lomb Appoints Thomas Appio as Interim CEOWhat does this mean competitively?If the European Commission approves Foundayo, it would become the second oral GLP-1 available in the EU for weight management, following Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy pill, which received European approval in July for weight management only. In the type 2 diabetes setting, Foundayo would compete with Novo’s Rybelsus brand of oral semaglutide, which has been on the European market since 2020 and has grown into a multi-billion-dollar franchise. The CHMP recommendation opens a new competitive front between Lilly and Novo Nordisk in Europe’s oral GLP-1 market, adding to their existing rivalry in injectable incretin therapies.What did the clinical evidence show?The weight management recommendation is based on two studies involving more than 4,740 adults with obesity or overweight. The type 2 diabetes recommendation is based on four studies involving 3,765 adults compared against placebo, dapagliflozin, and oral semaglutide.FDA Approves Enspryng for Thyroid Eye DiseaseWhat was approved?The FDA approved Enspryng (satralizumab), an interleukin-6 receptor inhibitor developed by Roche, for adults with thyroid eye disease on October 16. Roche describes it as the first subcutaneous therapy for the condition — one that patients or caregivers can administer at home after training from a healthcare provider. It is Enspryng’s second indication; the drug was first approved in 2020 for neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder.What did the clinical trials show?The approval rests on two identically designed Phase 3 trials, SatraGO-1 and SatraGO-2, which enrolled 258 adults across 19 countries. The primary endpoint was the proportion of patients with active, moderate-to-severe disease who achieved at least a 2 mm reduction in proptosis — eye bulging — at week 24. Results diverged: SatraGO-2 met its endpoint, with 52.9% of Enspryng-treated patients achieving a proptosis response versus 23.4% on placebo, and 60.7% showing reduced double vision versus 25.8%. SatraGO-1 did not reach statistical significance, with researchers attributing the gap to an unexpectedly high placebo response.How does this change the treatment landscape?Two disease-specific therapies were already approved — Tepezza and, more recently, Lumvoa — both administered by intravenous infusion. Enspryng’s subcutaneous, every-four-week maintenance dosing offers a different treatment experience, with the key benefit being reduced logistical burden rather than a demonstrated efficacy advantage over existing options. No head-to-head comparison with approved therapies was conducted.What are the remaining unknowns?Roche did not disclose pricing or launch timing. Long-term data beyond week 24 were not described in available sources. Separately, the FDA has granted priority review to a supplemental Enspryng application for myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease, with a decision expected in January 2027. Insitro will receive $40 million upfront and is eligible for up to approximately $1.46 billion in development and commercial milestones, plus single-digit royalties on global sales.What is insitro’s platform?Insitro’s Virtual Human platform combines large-scale human and cellular data with AI-enabled target identification and medicine design. The company was founded in 2018 and reports more than $750 million in capital raised, with existing collaborations with Bristol Myers Squibb, Lilly and Gilead. It has nine programs in development, including genetic regulators of liver fat and fibrosis expected to enter the clinic in early 2027.Why MASH and cardiomyopathies?Both conditions are characterized by disease heterogeneity — a single diagnostic label covering patients whose underlying biology differs — which has complicated treatment development. In MASH, the FDA approved its first treatment, resmetirom (Rezdiffra), in March 2024, but the condition still lacks therapeutic options for most of the estimated 6 to 8 million US patients with moderate-to-advanced liver scarring. The cardiomyopathy scope was not specified in the announcement.What are the limitations of this deal?No drug candidates were named in the announcement. The collaboration sits at the discovery stage, with targets identified through AI-driven analysis still requiring validation through preclinical and clinical work. The $40 million upfront represents less than 3% of the total headline value, and neither company disclosed timelines for milestone payments.FDA Launches Rare Disease Framework InitiativeWhat is the Rare Disease Framework Initiative?The FDA announced a new effort to redesign how drugs and biologics for rare diseases are developed and reviewed. The initiative, outlined in a white paper released by the agency’s Rare Disease Innovation Hub, aims to build a regulatory framework tailored to the realities of small patient populations — covering clinical development, evidence standards, manufacturing review, and the role of patient voice throughout the process.Why is FDA doing this now?Despite years of regulatory flexibility programs for rare diseases, only approximately 5% of rare conditions currently have an FDA-approved treatment. The agency says that gap reflects the need for a more fundamentally tailored approach rather than incremental adjustments to a framework originally designed for common diseases.What are the specific commitments?The initiative outlines six priority areas: greater clarity and predictability in regulatory decision-making through tailored guidance; embedding the patient voice early and at defined milestones; leveraging external expertise for customized review; building shared institutional knowledge; applying risk-based approaches to manufacturing and pre-approval inspections; and championing innovative statistical approaches in rare disease development.What happens next?The FDA is hosting a public meeting on October 28 at its White Oak campus, facilitated by the Reagan-Udall Foundation, to gather input from patients, disease advocates, industry, and other stakeholders. Additional sector-specific roundtables and requests for information will follow. The detailed framework development — which could include new guidance, regulatory changes, and organizational changes within FDA — will be informed by that input.Gilead and Vir Biotechnology Enter $1.87 Billion Masked T-Cell Engager CollaborationWhat are the two companies agreeing to develop?Vir Biotechnology will discover and optimize three novel PRO-XTEN dual-masked T-cell engager development candidates for Gilead, targeting selected solid tumor-associated antigens. Gilead holds an exclusive license to develop, manufacture and commercialize the resulting therapies. Vir will receive $90 million upfront — including $65 million in cash and a $25 million equity investment at a 30% premium — and is eligible for up to $1.74 billion in additional milestones and tiered royalties.What is the PRO-XTEN masking technology?PRO-XTEN is designed to keep T-cell engagers inactive in circulation until they reach the tumor microenvironment, where tumor-specific proteases cleave the mask and activate the drug’s cancer-killing mechanism. That conditional activation is intended to limit systemic toxicity — one of the primary barriers to TCE use in solid tumors — while extending the drug’s half-life and potentially enabling less frequent dosing.Why does this matter for solid tumor oncology?T-cell engagers have proven highly effective in blood cancers but have faced significant limitations in solid tumors, where toxicity and the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment have constrained clinical use. Vir’s PRO-XTEN approach directly targets those barriers. This is the second major PRO-XTEN collaboration — an earlier $1.7 billion deal with Astellas for a PSMA-targeted TCE in prostate cancer was announced in February 2026. Together the two deals bring total PRO-XTEN platform value to more than $3.6 billion across two top-tier pharma partners.How does this fit Gilead’s oncology strategy?Today’s deal is Gilead’s third major solid tumor oncology transaction in 2026, following the $5 billion Tubulis ADC acquisition in April and the $2.1 billion Ouro Medicines BCMA T-cell engager acquisition in March. Gilead is simultaneously building in ADCs, T-cell engagers for autoimmune disease, and now masked T-cell engagers for solid tumors — a deliberate multi-mechanism oncology buildout executed across a single year.Bausch + Lomb Appoints Thomas Appio as Interim CEOWhat happened at Bausch + Lomb?Bausch + Lomb announced that Brent Saunders departed as CEO by mutual agreement, with Thomas J. Appio named interim CEO effective immediately. Appio, who will retain his role as CEO of parent company Bausch Health, steps into the position just weeks before the company reports third-quarter results and updates its full-year guidance on October 28.What does the company expect for 2026?Simultaneously with the leadership announcement, both Bausch + Lomb and Bausch Health said they expect to raise their full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance based on preliminary third-quarter results, citing strong business performance and anticipated momentum through year-end.What was Saunders building?Saunders returned to Bausch + Lomb in March 2023 — his second stint as CEO — and spent three years stabilizing the company’s supply chain, accelerating commercial execution, and rebuilding its R&D pipeline. He is also the author of the morning Pharmalittle newsletter and the afternoon Pharmalot newsletter. Good morning, everyone, and welcome to another working week. We hope the weekend respite was relaxing and invigorating because that oh-too-familiar routine of meetings, deadlines, and the like has returned with a vengeance. But what can you do? The world, such as it is, continues to rotate. To nudge it in a better direction, we are brewing another cup of stimulation. Our choice today is butter pecan with a dash of raw honey. Feel free to join us. Remember, no prescription is required. Meanwhile, here are some tidbits to help you along. Best of luck accomplishing your goals today, and of course, do keep in touch. … Bristol Myers Squibb reported that one patient died after receiving its investigational CAR-T therapy in an early autoimmune trial, adding to safety concerns about a growing field of research, STAT notes. In a Phase 1 trial that tested the therapy in multiple sclerosis, the patient experienced motor symptoms that did not resolve with standard autoimmune treatments. They were then given a potent immunosuppressant, but developed septic pneumonia and died, Bristol said in a press release. In a subsequent statement, Bristol said this patient was treated for a series of other complications prior to receiving the CAR-T therapy, “confounding our ability to determine the root cause of the issue.”Advertisement A Roche drug billed as a potential blockbuster helped patients with a form of lung cancer that had spread live almost six months longer than two competitive medicines, Bloomberg News says. The experimental treatment, called divarasib, fared better than similar drugs from Amgen and Bristol Myers Squibb in a late-stage study. The drug was given to patients with non-small cell lung cancer that had spread, in part because of a genetic mutation, after other treatments, including chemotherapy. The findings could help divarasib become the treatment of choice for this type of lung cancer, in which a mutation called KRAS G12C drives the tumor cell growth. title: Corxel, an obesity drugmaker, to go public via SPAC deal
content: An article from Dive Brief // Obesity drugs Corxel, an obesity drugmaker, to go public via SPAC deal Armed with a $300 million financing and two GLP-1 and amylin-targeting medicines, Corxel is set to become the latest weight loss-focused company to join the public markets. Published Oct. 26, 2026 Gwendolyn Wu Senior Reporter Share Copy link Email LinkedIn X/Twitter Facebook Print License Add us on Google Corxel U.S. will go public via a merger with the SPAC Amanat Acquisition Corp., the companies announced Oct. 26, 2026. Michael Santiago/Getty Images via Getty Images Dive Brief: Corxel Pharmaceuticals, a drug startup developing a pair of weight loss medicines, announced Monday plans to go public by merging with a special purpose acquisition company. The SPAC deal and concurrent $300 million private investment will help Corxel take CX11, a GLP-1 pill licensed from the Chinese drug developer Vincentage Pharma, into late-stage testing. In June, Corxel said CX11 helped participants in a U.S. Phase 2 trial lose an average of up to 11.5% of their body weight after 36 weeks while displaying a “favorable” gastrointestinal tolerability profile. The combined company will also advance a preclinical weight loss prospect directed at a different gut hormone known as amylin. A third drug licensed from Biogen and in development for acute ischemic stroke isn't part of the deal and will instead be housed in a parent entity. Corxel's backers made clear in subsequent talks that they wanted the company to have a "more dedicated focus," rather than pursue "two different tracks," said Kevin Xie, its chief financial officer, in an interview with BioPharma Dive. What followed was a split, with two obesity drugs being merged into a publicly traded entity and the rest of Corxel funneled into a still-private parent. “Both companies have separate development strategies and financing processes, so that’s more welcome news to the investors,” Xie said. Formerly known as Ji Xing Pharmaceuticals, Corxel launched in 2019 and once planned to develop a nasal spray for dry eye disease. It offloaded that therapy in 2024, the same year it acquired from Biogen most rights to JX10 and licensed CX11 from Vincentage. CX11 was already in human testing when Corxel struck that deal. Now it’s on the verge of a global late-stage study. Corxel reported positive late-stage data in May from a Chinese trial run by Vincentage. An international Phase 3 test could follow as soon as the first quarter of 2027. Corxel is pitching CX11 as a “differentiated, next-generation” therapy and an option for people who don’t stay on injectable GLP-1s. Though it is well behind first-to-market oral GLP-1s like Eli Lilly’s Foundayo and Novo’s Wegovy pill, Xie said CX11 may be appealing to people who need to lose 5% to 10% of their body weight and are classified as overweight, but not obese. (Around 31% of U.S. adults fit this description, according to one National Institutes of Health estimate.) Corxel is testing higher doses of CX11 in a Phase 1b trial in an effort to explore the drug’s “efficacy upside,” according to a statement. Additional data are expected in the first half of 2027.
